parsed.notes: Reviewed all 6 rows in group_inventory.jsonl. No black-letter assertion rows were present for Lens A review.

reasons: The lake record identifies Wearry v. Cain as a U.S. Supreme Court case decided 2016-03-07.

The cited reporters in the assertion match the lake citations: 577 U.S. 385, 136 S. Ct. 1002, 194 L. Ed. 2d 78, 2016 U.S. LEXIS 1654, 84 U.S.L.W. 4125, 26 Fla. L. Weekly Fed. S 17, and 2016 WL 854158.
The quoted phrase “cumulative evaluation” appears in the disclosed opinion text in the Kyles citation passage.
The lake pinpoint pin-1007 also records quote_fidelity as matched and gives a validated text fragment for cumulative evaluation.
residual_risks: The text cache is slip-format; no independent S. Ct. page marker is available in the cached text.

defect.evidence_quote:
The State’s
trial evidence resembles a house of cards, built on the jury
crediting Scott’s account rather than Wearry’s alibi.
defect.problem: The asserted quote is not character-faithful. The opinion says “The State’s trial evidence resembles...”; the page/lake quote changes that to “resemble[d]...” and omits the subject.
defect.proposed_fix: Quote the opinion as: “The State’s trial evidence resembles a house of cards, built on the jury crediting Scott’s account rather than Wearry’s alibi.”

reasons: Bracketed alteration may be intelligible legally, but it is not character-faithful under this review lens.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the full sentence or paraphrase without quotation marks.

defect.evidence_quote:
He must show only that the new evi-
dence is sufficient to “undermine confidence” in the ver-
dict.
defect.problem: The quote is substantively close but not character-faithful to the disclosed opinion text; the source uses double curly quotation marks around “undermine confidence,” not straight single quotation marks.
defect.proposed_fix: Use: “He must show only that the new evidence is sufficient to “undermine confidence” in the verdict.” Or paraphrase without quotation marks.

reasons: The lake itself marks pin-1006a quote_fidelity as mismatch.
The cached opinion text confirms the quoted words but not the exact quotation punctuation used on the page.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Normalize the quotation to the opinion’s punctuation or remove verbatim quotation styling.

defect.evidence_quote:
Evidence qualifies as material when there is “ ‘any
reasonable likelihood’ ” it could have “ ‘affected the judg-
ment of the jury.’ ”
defect.problem: The asserted pin-1006 quote is not an opinion quote at all; it captures page/front-matter and summary text before the actual rule quotation. The lake marks this pinpoint as a mismatch.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-1006 with the actual opinion sentence beginning “Evidence qualifies as material...”

reasons: The payload quote begins with page metadata and background text, not Wearry’s opinion text.
The disclosed opinion contains the intended materiality sentence, but not the asserted front-matter block.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Fix the nested quotation markup around the materiality rule so extraction does not swallow preceding page content.

reasons: The treatment fields asserted on the content page match the lake record: good_law, as_of_content 2016-03-07, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point false, and the same scope note.
Lens A records this field match only; treatment/currency merits are outside this lens.
residual_risks: Treatment/currency was not independently attacked under Lens A.
